sources.entry: explore-claude-code by Luke Renton - An interactive click-through of an annotated Claude Code project where every file and folder — CLAUDE.md, settings.json, rules, commands, skills, agents, hooks, plugins, and .mcp.json — is a real, explained concept, teaching the tool's surface area by orientation rather than prose.

summary.one_liner: An interactive, static click-through site that teaches Claude Code by letting you browse an annotated simulated project whose files and folders each explain a real Claude Code feature.
summary.what_it_does: The repo contains a static single-page site (HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript) that simulates a Claude Code project with a file tree in the sidebar. Clicking a file or folder such as CLAUDE.md, .claude/settings.json, rules, commands, skills, agents, hooks, plugins, .mcp.json, or src/ opens an explanation of that concept, setup steps, and annotated config examples. A built-in/ section covers features that ship with Claude Code, such as bundled skills like /simplify, /batch, and /code-review. Navigation includes a Ctrl/Cmd+K search palette, arrow-key stepping through files, copy-link deep links, light and dark themes, and a terminal panel that emulates some slash commands like /help, /init, and /doctor. Content is driven by site/data/manifest.json and markdown/config files in site/content/.
use_cases: Learning Claude Code's project configuration by example
Looking up how to set up CLAUDE.md, settings.json, or hooks
Copying annotated Claude Code scaffolding into a new project
Browsing bundled Claude Code slash commands and skills
Finding how MCP server config (.mcp.json) is structured
Offline or local browsing of Claude Code docs via a static server
how_to_run: Or open site/index.html directly in a browser
notable: Every file in the simulated project is a real, annotated Claude Code concept rather than prose about it
Zero build step, no frameworks or bundlers; runs from any static server or by opening index.html
Splits content into project config under .claude/ and out-of-the-box features under built-in/
Manifest-driven: manifest.json defines the tree, badges, and content references
Terminal panel with a slash-command emulator and progress tracking stored in localStorage
caveats: The README does not describe a Claude Code CLI integration; the terminal panel is a simulated emulator
The README's git clone command is missing its URL, so the exact clone address must be taken from the repository page
keywords: how to set up claude code
